# Nizlo MSP Operations Resources

> Public, ungated field guides, operational resources, reusable CSV templates, and a source-dated RMM pricing dataset for managed service providers and lean IT teams defining requirements, evaluating, pricing, testing, integrating, deploying, inventorying, operating, securing, reporting, recovering, migrating, onboarding, and offboarding remote monitoring and management software.

This external library is maintained by the Nizlo team. Nizlo is a Windows-first RMM and IT-management platform. The resources are vendor-neutral, but they are vendor-created and do not represent independent research or an endorsement of Nizlo.

## Primary pages

- [Resource library](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/): Human-readable collection of all maintained guides.
- [RMM alert-noise baseline worksheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-alert-noise-baseline-worksheet.html): A 14-day before-and-after method and 23-field CSV for measuring events, incidents, duplicates, false positives, actionable yield, after-hours burden, acknowledgement, and resolution.
- [RMM alert not creating a ticket troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-alert-not-creating-ticket-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for alert eligibility, suppression, route selection, mapping, API delivery, retry and deduplication safety, ticket ownership, recovery, and closure, with a reusable [twelve-field CSV evidence worksheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-alert-not-creating-ticket-troubleshooting-checklist.csv).
- [RMM RFP requirements matrix template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-requirements-matrix-template.html): Thirty-two example requirements and 18 decision fields for comparable vendor responses, priority, business reason, evidence, pilot tests, acceptance criteria, dependencies, gaps, remediation, and final decisions.
- [RMM RFP template and buyer guide](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-rfp-template?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_rfp_template): Vendor-neutral Markdown template and issue-to-decision workflow for scope, evidence requests, security, implementation, pricing, exit terms, pilot acceptance, and approvals.
- [RMM vendor due-diligence evidence register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-vendor-due-diligence-evidence-register.html): Thirty review controls for vendor evidence, findings, risk, remediation, exceptions, and renewal review.
- [RMM security checklist and evidence register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-security-evidence-checklist.html): Thirty controls for tenant isolation, identity, agent enrollment, privileged actions, remote access, audit evidence, recovery, data lifecycle, and offboarding, with a public 15-field CSV.
- [RMM audit log review checklist: 24-control evidence register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-audit-log-review-checklist.html): Twenty-four controls for actor, tenant, endpoint, action, outcome, retention, export, monitoring, investigation, exception, and retest evidence, with a public 15-field CSV and primary CISA logging context.
- [RMM vendor exit plan checklist and evidence register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-vendor-exit-plan-checklist.html): Thirty-two controls for contracts, inventory, exports, automation, integrations, credentials, replacement readiness, coexistence, cutover, source removal, access revocation, data disposition, commercial closure, acceptance, and stabilization, with a public 16-field CSV.
- [Free RMM API integration checklist and CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-api-integration-preflight-checklist.html): Eighteen evidence checks and a public nine-field CSV for integration identity, least privilege, tenant isolation, pagination, rate limits, retries, idempotency, webhooks, audit logs, rollback, monitoring, ownership, and acceptance.
- [n8n RMM integration: read-only MSP workflows](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/n8n-rmm-integration.html): Public source, supported read operations and filters, GitHub installation path, two inactive credential-free workflow examples, permission boundary, and a seven-step evaluation sequence.
- [RMM alert escalation matrix](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-alert-escalation-matrix-template.html): Twenty-seven example alert rules with severity, confirmation, ownership, time targets, escalation, communication, suppression, evidence, closure, and tuning fields.
- [RMM monitoring policy template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-monitoring-policy-template.html): Thirty-two vendor-neutral controls for scope, baselines, thresholds, severity, routing, maintenance behavior, response, recovery, testing, exceptions, and recurring review.
- [RMM maintenance window and alert suppression policy](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-maintenance-window-alert-suppression-policy.html): Twenty-eight vendor-neutral controls for exact maintenance scope, independent collection and routing behavior, approval, hard expiry, compensating coverage, extension, post-window reconciliation, and closure evidence.
- [RMM for Azure Virtual Desktop session hosts checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-for-azure-virtual-desktop-session-hosts-checklist.html): Twenty-eight vendor-neutral checks for pooled-host identity, images, AVD and guest signals, patch authority, capacity, remote access, agent coexistence, licensing, and removal.
- [MSP SLA response time template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-sla-response-time-template.html): Four example priority rows and 20 fields for response, restoration, resolution, clock rules, responsibilities, escalation, exclusions, evidence, and approval; time targets remain placeholders.
- [RMM alert escalation policy guide](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-alert-escalation-policy-template): Maintained implementation guidance for adapting the matrix into owned severity rules, time targets, handoffs, evidence requirements, and operational tests.
- [RMM alert noise reduction checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-alert-noise-reduction-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for baselines, thresholds, confirmation, deduplication, routing, suppression, ownership, evidence, and measured tuning outcomes.
- [RMM agent uninstall verification checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-agent-uninstall-verification-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for authority, inventory, uninstall execution, access revocation, residual artifacts, post-removal monitoring, and closure evidence.
- [RMM agent repair vs reinstall decision matrix](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-agent-repair-vs-reinstall-decision-matrix.html): Four vendor-neutral decision paths for supported agent repair, module repair, controlled reinstall, or stop-and-escalate, with a downloadable [ten-field CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-agent-repair-reinstall-decision-matrix.csv), evidence gates, success tests, and closure rules.
- [RMM endpoint disappeared: first 15 minutes and repair-or-reinstall checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-agent-offline-troubleshooting-checklist.html): A bounded five-stage evidence sequence plus twenty-four vendor-neutral controls and a [Markdown quick reference](https://gist.github.com/izikipizi/bd7eaa85da9ac50b4eeeb78f4ea6233b) for service, binary, transport, enrollment identity, console visibility, supported repair, controlled reinstall, and record reconciliation.
- [RMM agent certificate or TLS enrollment failure troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-agent-certificate-tls-enrollment-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for endpoint time, DNS, proxy, TLS, trust-chain, revocation, inspection, policy, enrollment identity, bounded repair, and functional recovery, with a reusable CSV worksheet.
- [RMM script not running or job stuck troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-script-not-running-job-stuck-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for targeting, queue delivery, endpoint state, execution context, local evidence, idempotency, safe retry, result validation, and fleet reconciliation, with a reusable [twelve-field CSV evidence worksheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-script-not-running-job-stuck-troubleshooting-checklist.csv).
- [RMM software deployment or application install failed troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-software-deployment-install-failed-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for package identity, delivery state, prerequisites, execution context, installer logs and return codes, security controls, detection, partial state, safe canary retry, and cohort reconciliation, with a reusable [twelve-field CSV evidence worksheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-software-deployment-install-failed-troubleshooting-checklist.csv).
- [RMM agent high CPU or memory troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-agent-high-cpu-memory-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for scoping, baselining, workload correlation, performance counters, Windows Performance Recorder traces, safe remediation, retesting, and closure evidence.
- [RMM agent upgrade failed or stuck troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-agent-upgrade-failed-stuck-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for preserving installer evidence, validating packages and prerequisites, isolating concurrency, lock, path, and security-control failures, repairing one pilot, and reconciling the rollout cohort.
- [MSP service desk diagnostic handoff checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-service-desk-diagnostic-handoff-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for endpoint context, comparable measurements, reproducible symptoms, work performed, facts versus hypotheses, explicit escalation questions, receipt, retest, and closure.
- [RMM duplicate device or cloned agent identity troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-duplicate-device-identity-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for preserving identity evidence, finding golden-image, reinstall, shared-key, or stale-import causes, containing privileged automation, reconciling records, and preventing recurrence.
- [RMM first-endpoint activation troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-first-endpoint-activation-troubleshooting-checklist.html): A vendor-neutral evidence path from installer execution through service state, tenant enrollment, outbound connectivity, and verified dashboard telemetry.
- [RMM remote access session authorization checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-remote-access-session-authorization-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral controls for authority, technician identity, attended and unattended session approval, scoped work, audit evidence, revocation, and review.
- [RMM remote access not connecting troubleshooting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-remote-access-not-connecting-troubleshooting-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for authority, endpoint and support-service state, DNS, proxy, TLS, relay health, session lifecycle, blank-screen evidence, bounded repair, retesting, and closure, with a reusable CSV worksheet.
- [RMM vs remote desktop software](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-vs-remote-desktop-software.html): Eight evidence checks for separating remote desktop connection management, technician support sessions, and continuous RMM fleet operations.
- [RMM vs Intune vs MDM vs endpoint management](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-vs-remote-support-vs-mdm-vs-endpoint-management.html): A buyer map for separating continuous RMM operations from Microsoft Intune and MDM device governance, technician sessions, and broader endpoint administration, including overlap and coexistence checks.
- [RMM vs MDM responsibility matrix CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-vs-mdm-responsibility-matrix.csv): Eighteen overlap domains for assigning the primary system of authority, supporting system, named owner, evidence, conflict risk, pilot test, decision, exception owner, and review date.
- [RMM vs PSA software](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-vs-psa-software.html): Ten buyer checks for separating endpoint operations from tickets, agreements, SLAs, time, billing, and service ownership, plus a bounded integration pilot.
- [RMM patch-compliance report template and calculator](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-patch-compliance-calculator.html): Free 20-field CSV report plus browser-only strict compliance math with an explicit endpoint denominator and visible pending-reboot, failed, unpatched, excluded, stale, and unknown states.
- [MSP backup restore test checklist and CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-backup-restore-test-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks and a public nine-field CSV for recovery scope, recovery-point evidence, isolated restore execution, integrity, permissions, application validation, RPO, RTO, exception ownership, safe cleanup, and closure.
- [Windows patch failure triage checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/windows-patch-failure-triage-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral checks for failure evidence, Windows Update log collection, fleet scope, prerequisites, servicing health, safe retry, post-change validation, exception ownership, and closure, plus primary Microsoft references and a [twelve-field Windows Update log evidence worksheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/windows-update-log-evidence-worksheet.csv).
- [MSP daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly maintenance checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-daily-weekly-monthly-maintenance-checklist.html): Twenty-eight recurring checks with healthy signals, exception triggers, evidence requirements, ownership, review, status, and linked work records.
- [RMM pilot test plan and evidence pack](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-pilot-test-evidence-pack.html): Twenty-five controlled proof-of-concept tests with pass criteria, evidence, stop conditions, defects, remediation, retesting, and rollout decisions.
- [Six-week MSP onboarding project plan](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/six-week-msp-onboarding-project-plan.html): Thirty milestones for authority, discovery, access, SOP development, controlled pilot execution, reconciliation, NOC training, acceptance, and handoff.
- [How to test RMM software safely](https://nizlo.com/guides/how-to-test-rmm-software?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_trial_pilot_checklist): Staged pre-production pilot for agents, permissions, monitoring, patching, automation, remote access, and removal, with a [downloadable 12-step Markdown worksheet](https://nizlo.com/guides/how-to-test-rmm-software/checklist.md?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_download&utm_campaign=rmm_trial_pilot_checklist).
- [Mac RMM & Windows RMM: Mixed-Fleet Checklist](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-for-mac-and-windows): Mixed-fleet evaluation across enrollment, inventory, alerts, automation, updates, remote access, and removal.
- [RMM for a new MSP](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-for-new-msps): First-customer buying guide covering operational simplicity, real costs, pilot scope, and lock-in.
- [RMM for computer repair shops](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-for-computer-repair-shops?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=computer_repair_rmm): Guide for turning break/fix work into a bounded managed-service offer with defined scope, pricing, first-endpoint acceptance, and escalation rules.
- [RMM free trial](https://nizlo.com/solutions/rmm-free-trial?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_free_trial): A 14-day, no-card evaluation path for testing one representative endpoint, retaining evidence, and making a stop, extend, or adopt decision.
- [RMM for small IT teams](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-for-small-it-teams): Practical evaluation guide for internal IT teams weighing RMM, Intune, and a safe pilot.
- [RMM pricing 2026 calculator](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-pricing-models): Calculate costs for 10, 25, 50, 100, or 500 endpoints and compare per-device, per-technician, flat monthly, add-on, and annual totals.
- [RMM software comparison directory](https://nizlo.com/compare): Fifty-four head-to-head and alternative guides covering pricing, endpoint coverage, patching, automation, remote support, integrations, deployment, and controlled-pilot fit.
- [Atera alternative migration path](https://nizlo.com/compare/atera-alternative?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_migration_paths): Source-dated pricing, trial, PSA, platform, patching, automation, remote-support, and pilot-scope comparison linked to the common migration workflow.
- [ConnectWise RMM alternative migration path](https://nizlo.com/compare/connectwise-rmm-alternative?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_migration_paths): Source-dated package, quote, ScreenConnect, platform, patching, automation, API, and controlled-pilot comparison.
- [Datto RMM alternative migration path](https://nizlo.com/compare/datto-rmm-alternative?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_migration_paths): Source-dated comparison of quote-based scope, Autotask alignment, platform breadth, patching, automation, remote support, and pilot fit.
- [SuperOps alternative migration path](https://nizlo.com/compare/superops-alternative?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_migration_paths): Source-dated comparison of public pricing, RMM and PSA scope, endpoint coverage, automation, remote support, and pilot boundaries.
- [Syncro alternative migration path](https://nizlo.com/compare/syncro-alternative?utm_source=llms_txt&utm_medium=resource_index&utm_campaign=rmm_migration_paths): Source-dated comparison of technician pricing, unlimited-endpoint economics, PSA maturity, scripting, platform breadth, and controlled migration fit.
- [RMM vs MDM](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-vs-mdm): Compare endpoint operations with managed-device enrollment, compliance, application, security-policy, and retirement controls, including when an MSP or IT team needs both.
- [ManageEngine Endpoint Central alternative for MSPs](https://nizlo.com/compare/manageengine-endpoint-central-msp-alternative): Source-dated comparison of current entry pricing, trial length, endpoint limits, platform breadth, patching, remote access, APIs, deployment, and controlled-pilot fit.
- [RMM vs. Microsoft Intune](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-vs-intune): Comparison of multi-tenant operations, monitoring, scripts, patching, application management, remote support, and cost.
- [Windows patch policy template for MSPs](https://nizlo.com/guides/windows-patch-policy-template): Vendor-neutral policy template for scope, deployment rings, deadlines, restart controls, exceptions, emergency changes, rollback, evidence, and review.
- [Windows patch policy Markdown download](https://nizlo.com/guides/windows-patch-policy-template/template.md): No-gate reusable policy document with decision tables, deployment rings, exception fields, cycle evidence, and approvals.
- [RMM patch management policy checklist for Windows](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/windows-patch-policy-review-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral controls for authority, scope, update classes, rings, deadlines, restarts, exceptions, rollback, evidence, and policy review.
- [RMM staged-rollout and rollback-plan template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-change-window-rollback-plan.html): Field guidance and a public 30-control CSV for signed-package checks, canary stop gates, rollback authorization, post-rollback binary proof, endpoint reconciliation, and rollout-boundary evidence.
- [RMM incident response runbook template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-incident-response-runbook-template.html): Field guidance and a public 30-control CSV for RMM security incident readiness, containment, investigation, recovery, and improvement.
- [RMM incident response tabletop exercise template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-incident-response-tabletop-exercise.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral scenario injects for testing independent command, scope, containment, evidence, communications, recovery, closure, and retesting without improvising production actions.
- [RMM incident postmortem template and corrective action register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-incident-postmortem-template.html): Twenty-four evidence questions for reconciling scope, impact, timeline, response, cause, controls, corrective actions, retesting, accepted risk, and closure.
- [RMM incident response checklist](https://nizlo.com/guides/rmm-incident-response-checklist): Eight-stage guide covering preparation, declaration, scope, containment, evidence, recovery, reconciliation, and corrective action.
- [RMM agent blocked by EDR troubleshooting and allowlisting checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-edr-allowlisting-checklist.html): Public, vendor-neutral workflow and CSV for preserving the alert, verifying the RMM binary and tenant, testing a narrow exception, submitting a suspected false positive, retaining telemetry, and reviewing or removing the change.
- [MSP endpoint exception register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-endpoint-exception-register.html): Public, vendor-neutral 15-field CSV for recording endpoint, access, patching, security, monitoring, and service exceptions from request through approval, review, expiry, and closure.
- [RMM migration plan template and checklist workbook](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-migration-workbook-template.html): Adjustable six-stage project-plan guidance and a public 30-control CSV for discovery, pilot, coexistence, cutover, validation, source retirement, and closeout.
- [RMM ROI, migration cost, and payback calculator](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-migration-cost-calculator.html): Browser-only modeling for migration labor, fees, subscription overlap, retained tools, recurring savings, 12-month ROI, 36-month value, and payback time with published formulas.
- [RMM contract renewal deadline calculator](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-contract-renewal-deadline-calculator.html): Browser-only calculation of non-renewal notice deadlines, earlier internal decision dates, days remaining, copyable timelines, and downloadable calendar reminders.
- [RMM contract renewal checklist and non-renewal notice template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-contract-renewal-checklist-nonrenewal-notice-template.html): Twelve-step operational review for controlling documents, notice rules, delivery, complete cost, operating evidence, exports, transition obligations, approval, proof, and a copyable notice starting point.
- [RMM pricing and contract comparison worksheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-quote-comparison-worksheet.html): Vendor-neutral worksheet for normalizing pricing units, endpoint minimums, included technicians and endpoints, add-ons, contract length, renewals, cancellation, and exit costs.
- [Free RMM calculators](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-calculators.html): Collection page for migration cost, public price comparison, pricing-model, and ROI calculators, with explicit limitations and no email gate.
- [Citation and preservation](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/citation.html): Authorship, version, repository, CFF metadata, and Software Heritage identifiers.
- [Machine-readable resource index](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/resource-index.json): Structured catalogue with titles, categories, audiences, access status, and canonical URLs.
- [Data Package descriptor](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/datapackage.json): Standards-based metadata, schemas, byte counts, and SHA-256 hashes for reusable templates and the public pricing dataset.
- [Atom feed](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/feed.xml): Feed-reader and aggregator discovery for the resource collection.

## Pricing data

- [RMM pricing transparency dataset](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/public-rmm-pricing-dataset.html): Fourteen source-dated disclosures with a per-endpoint versus per-technician billing-model comparison—six fully numeric across four endpoint scenarios, four quote-only, two free-tier-only, one range-plus-quote, and one source-available—with normalized one-technician math only where public rates permit it.
- [Download the source-dated CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/data/public-rmm-pricing-comparison-2026-11-02.csv): Machine-readable November 2, 2026 snapshot licensed under CC BY 4.0.

## Reusable templates

- [RMM network device monitoring acceptance checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-network-device-monitoring-acceptance-checklist.html): Twenty-four vendor-neutral tests for approved scope, inventory reconciliation, pollers, SNMP security, stable identity, metrics, alert routing, dependency failure, outages, recovery, and acceptance; explicitly notes that Nizlo does not currently claim SNMP or network-discovery support.
- [RMM network device monitoring acceptance CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-network-device-monitoring-acceptance-checklist.csv): Nine fields for evidence, bounded pilot tests, decisions, owners, and notes across the 24 acceptance controls.

- [MSP QBR agenda and client report checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-qbr-agenda-client-report-checklist.html): Twenty-four evidence-led review items across service health, endpoint coverage, monitoring, patching, security, projects, continuity, commercial scope, decisions, and next-quarter actions.
- [MSP QBR agenda and evidence CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-qbr-agenda-client-report-checklist.csv): Fourteen fields for source evidence, metric definitions, comparison periods, provider and client owners, decisions, due dates, status, and evidence links.

- [30 RMM vendor demo questions checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-vendor-demo-questions-checklist.html): Vendor-neutral sales-demo questions with evidence requests, bounded live tests, red flags, and decision notes.
- [RMM vendor demo questions CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-vendor-demo-questions-checklist.csv): Thirty questions across commercial scope, agent architecture, monitoring, patching, automation, remote access, security, integrations, implementation, support, and exit.

- [RMM operations and incident response template library](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/): Landing page for all forty-three public CSV templates with usage guidance.
- [RMM security evidence checklist CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-security-evidence-checklist.csv): Thirty controls and fifteen fields for evidence requests, validation, status, risk, remediation, exception approval, and retesting.
- [RMM audit log review checklist CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-audit-log-review-checklist.csv): Twenty-four controls and fifteen fields for audit scope, coverage, attribution, privileged workflows, retention, export, monitoring, investigations, exceptions, and retesting.
- [RMM API integration preflight CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-api-integration-preflight-checklist.csv): Eighteen controls and nine fields for production-readiness evidence, bounded pilot tests, decisions, owners, and notes.
- [MSP backup restore test checklist CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-backup-restore-test-checklist.csv): Twenty-four controls and nine fields for restore-drill evidence, test methods, status, ownership, and notes.
- [MSP SLA response time CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-sla-response-time-template.csv): Twenty fields for priority, impact, urgency, coverage, acknowledgement, restoration, resolution, clock rules, responsibilities, escalation, exclusions, evidence, and approval.
- [RMM alert-noise baseline CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-alert-noise-baseline.csv): Twenty-three fields and eight clearly marked example records for establishing and repeating an alert-noise baseline.
- [RMM requirements matrix CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-requirements-matrix.csv): Thirty-two clearly marked example requirements across governance, architecture, access, monitoring, patching, automation, remote access, inventory, security, implementation, commercial terms, support, and exit readiness.
- [RMM vendor due-diligence evidence register CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-vendor-due-diligence-evidence-register.csv): Seventeen fields for requested evidence, status, references, findings, risk, remediation, exceptions, and renewal dates.
- [RMM alert escalation matrix CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-alert-escalation-matrix.csv): Twenty-five fields for severity, confirmation, ownership, response, acknowledgement, escalation, customer communication, suppression, evidence, closure, and false-positive review.
- [MSP maintenance checklist CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-daily-weekly-monthly-maintenance-checklist.csv): Downloadable daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly service checks for backups, security, monitoring, patching, inventory, recovery, access, coverage, documentation, billing, integrations, and governance.
- [RMM pilot test evidence CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-pilot-test-evidence-pack.csv): Downloadable 25-test record for authority, identity, enrollment, monitoring, patching, automation, remote access, isolation, evidence, resilience, removal, remediation, retesting, and the final rollout decision.
- [RMM first-endpoint pilot acceptance checklist](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-first-endpoint-acceptance-checklist.html): Five evidence gates for identity, alert routing, authorized action, patch-state reconciliation, and clean removal before a pilot expands.
- [RMM first-endpoint acceptance CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-first-endpoint-acceptance.csv): Downloadable acceptance criteria, required evidence, rollout stop conditions, ownership, status, and notes.
- [Windows patch exception review and closure template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/windows-patch-exception-review-template.html): Guide and 18-control CSV for exception scope, evidence, risk, approval, compensating controls, monitoring, expiry, retest, and closure.
- [Windows patch exception review CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/windows-patch-exception-review.csv): Downloadable control record for time-bounded patch deferrals and their eventual disposition.
- [RMM implementation and deployment checklist template](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-deployment-readiness-template.html): Focused guide and 38-control CSV covering Group Policy, Intune/UEM, existing-RMM, manual, provisioning and custom-automation delivery; silent-install and retry behavior; identity safeguards; installation and enrollment failure evidence; pilot; wave rollout; verification; and closeout.
- [RMM staged-rollout and rollback-plan CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-change-window-rollback-plan.csv): 30 controls covering approval, pre-change evidence, canary rollout, stop conditions, signed rollback authority, approved-version proof, endpoint reconciliation, communications, and closure.
- [RMM incident response runbook CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-incident-response-runbook.csv): 30 controls covering readiness, detection, containment, investigation, recovery, communication, and corrective action.
- [RMM incident response tabletop exercise CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-incident-response-tabletop-exercise.csv): 24 decision injects with expected actions, authority, timeboxes, evidence, audiences, pass criteria, findings, owners, due dates, and retest dates.
- [RMM incident postmortem and corrective action CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-incident-postmortem-template.csv): 24 review questions with required outputs, evidence references, findings, severity, owners, due dates, validation methods, retest dates, and closure approval.
- [RMM migration workbook CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-migration-workbook.csv): 30 controls covering source inventory, target mapping, pilot evidence, coexistence, cutover, rollback, retirement, and closeout.
- [Interactive RMM evaluation scorecard and comparison calculator](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-evaluation-scorecard-template.html): Free browser-based weighting and 0–2 scoring across ten evidence-based pilot areas, with completion tracking, critical-zero warnings, a public CSV, risk ownership, retest, and go/no-go decision fields.
- [RMM contract and quote comparison worksheet CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/rmm-quote-comparison-worksheet.csv): Thirty fields for dated quote evidence, pricing units, minimums, platform and add-on fees, implementation, service dates, non-renewal notice windows, auto-renewal terms, first-year totals, renewal changes, termination, and exit costs.
- [Free endpoint inventory template and CMDB spreadsheet](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/endpoint-inventory-cmdb-template.html): Guide and 23-field CSV for durable device identity, ownership, lifecycle, management state, source provenance, freshness, exceptions, and safer CMDB imports.
- [RMM permissions matrix and technician access review](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/rmm-technician-access-review-matrix.html): Guide and 29-field CSV for reviewing technician and role scope, privileged capabilities, justification, MFA, approvals, review dates, decisions, exceptions, and remediation.
- [MSP client onboarding and go-live checklist with evidence register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-client-onboarding-evidence-register.html): Guide, six evidence-based go-live gates, and 30-control CSV for authority, discovery, access, RMM deployment, security, backup, service desk, documentation, service readiness, and acceptance.
- [Free MSP client onboarding checklist](https://nizlo.com/guides/msp-client-onboarding-checklist): Ten-step guide with 16 discovery questions plus reusable CSV and Markdown downloads for authority, assets, privileged access, recovery, endpoint enrollment, alerting, automation, reconciliation, and client acceptance.
- [MSP client onboarding evidence CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-client-onboarding-evidence-register.csv): Downloadable register for assigning owners, linking evidence, defining acceptance criteria, tracking exceptions, and closing onboarding controls.
- [MSP client onboarding questionnaire CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-client-onboarding-questionnaire.csv): Sixteen discovery questions covering business context, authority, scope, assets, identity, applications, networks, management tools, privileged access, governance, recovery, change control, escalation, known risks, and acceptance.
- [MSP client onboarding go-live acceptance CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/msp-client-onboarding-go-live-acceptance.csv): Six evidence-based gates for authority, inventory, access, monitoring, recovery, and handoff, with named MSP and customer acceptance plus explicit exception ownership.
- [Six-week MSP onboarding project plan CSV](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/templates/six-week-msp-onboarding-project-plan.csv): Downloadable 30-milestone plan with weekly tasks, owners, dependencies, deliverables, acceptance criteria, evidence, risks, and decision ownership.
- [MSP client offboarding checklist and evidence register](https://izikipizi.github.io/nizlo-msp-operations-resources/msp-client-offboarding-evidence-register.html): Guide and 32-control CSV for transition authority, inventory, secure handoff, access revocation, agent removal, data disposition, acceptance, and post-exit verification.
